title: Trump Signals US Could Resume Military Strikes Against Iran After Midterms
detail: President Trump told TIME magazine that the United States could resume or intensify military attacks against Iran following the midterm elections, raising the prospect of re-escalation after the recent US withdrawal from Iraq. The statement adds uncertainty to the post-withdrawal diplomatic environment and signals continued US military pressure as a tool in the Iran standoff.

title: Pentagon Raises Combat Pay for Troops Amid Sustained US-Iran War
detail: The Pentagon announced higher combat pay for troops deployed in operations tied to the ongoing US-Iran conflict, signaling continued US military commitment. The increase reflects the war's transition from an acute crisis phase to a sustained operational posture, with additional financial incentives designed to maintain troop readiness and retention ahead of anticipated midterm-era political pressure.

title: Poll: Most Americans Say US-Israel War on Iran Not Worth Fighting
detail: A new poll finds that a majority of Americans believe the US-Israel war on Iran is not worth fighting, reflecting deepening public skepticism as the conflict grinds into its seventh month ahead of the November midterm elections. The survey signals growing domestic political risk for the administration and may amplify pressure for a diplomatic off-ramp or drawdown of US forces.

media.caption: Poll shows majority of Americans oppose US-Israel war on Iran
